Why is the sky blue? In this video, we explain Rayleigh scattering in simple words — from why shorter wavelengths (blue and violet) scatter more than longer wavelengths (red and orange), to why the sky turns red at sunset, why it's blue and not violet, and why the Martian sky is butterscotch during the day but blue at sunset. Learn how tiny atmospheric particles scatter sunlight and paint the sky different colors.
Whether you're a physics student, curious about why sunsets are so colorful, or wondering what color the sky is on Mars, this beginner-friendly animated explainer covers it all.
